lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice words that are shorter than they look when we say them. They’re... …TRICKY WORDS! We don’t say every letter we can see: chocolate

Chocolate has three sounds, not four: cho-co-late is wrong. If we say every letter, the word gets one syllable too many.
